chose: sync the loaded board to the layout worker before a put stages, so the first put after a restart advances from the saved layout and resumes the layout world
over: resuming inside a refresh of the already-changed board
because: after a restart the layout client holds no sync, so advance fell back to refresh of the new board and the worker never saw the pre-put board the saved layout matches; staging mutates the element table in place, so only a snapshot taken before staging carries the old elements
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
